tiling_spec.pixel_size_note: Physical 100 m tiles / 25 m sub-graticule. At the 5 m native LOLA cell each tile is 20 px (Haworth's 1 m SfS tiling makes the same 100 m tile 100 px). Same physical spec, coarser native sampling -- physically consistent.
